summary_en: Palma announced an update to its capital cost-conscious management strategy. ROE target of 10% by September 2027 remains unchanged. The company will strengthen profitability through its medium-term plan, improve asset efficiency by accelerating asset sales, and pursue dividends with a 40% payout ratio as baseline while maintaining strategic flexibility on share buybacks.
title_en: Response to Achieve Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief:
Palma announced an update to its capital cost-conscious management strategy on November 13, 2026, following a board resolution. The company maintains its ROE target of 10% for the fiscal year ending September 2027, as outlined in its medium-term plan "Kaikaku 2027."

To achieve this target, the company will strengthen profitability through expanded BPO and IT service contracts and enhanced operational efficiency in its storage business, while accelerating asset sales to improve capital efficiency in its development and sales division. The company will also verify returns on new investment projects before committing capital and prioritize capital-conscious investment decisions.

For shareholder returns, Palma will target a dividend payout ratio of 40% as a baseline while adjusting distributions based on each period's earnings, internal reserves, and business outlook. Share buybacks will be considered flexibly based on performance trends and financial condition. The company reported a dividend of 13 yen per share for the fiscal year ending September 2026, including a commemorative dividend of 5 yen. As of September 2026, the company's PBR stood at 1.6x and PER at 28.8x, both exceeding the Standard Market average, reflecting investor confidence despite ROE of only 5.5% falling short of the 10% target.
